key.name: group-windows
key.summary: Group the focused window with the previously focused one

key.name: ungroup-window
key.summary: Take the focused window out of its group

key.name: next-tab
key.summary: Switch to the next tab in the focused group

key.name: previous-tab
key.summary: Switch to the previous tab in the focused group

key.name: hover-group-delay
key.summary: How long to hold a dragged window still over another, in milliseconds, before releasing groups them

key.name: tabs-on-all-windows
key.summary: Show a tab bar above windows that are not in a group

key.name: auto-group-same-app
key.summary: Put a new window into a group with other windows of its application on the same workspace

key.name: restore-groups
key.summary: Put windows back into their groups after logging in again

key.name: bar-height
key.summary: Height of the tab bar in pixels

key.name: bar-color
key.summary: Background color of the tab bar

key.name: active-tab-color
key.summary: Background color of the selected tab

key.name: text-color
key.summary: Color of tab titles and icons

key.name: saved-groups
key.summary: The groups to restore, as JSON. Written by the extension.
